document.about: Eppendorf Multipette E3/E3x data sheet. Its technical specifications are a label/value table ruled with horizontals alone, each rule broken at the column; four rows run three to six lines.

notes: A row over 3.5 times the median row height was taken for the gap between two tables: the table ended before it, and the tall rows' labels and values fell to paragraphs.

checks.issue: #105: `Intended use` was a paragraph, its value read after the next heading.

cell.value: Handheld electronic dispenser for general laboratory use. Intended for dispensing liquids in the volume range of 1 μL – 50 mL in combination with a matching Combitips® advanced or ViscoTip® dispenser tip.
> Temperature: 5 °C - 40 °C > Humidity: 10 % - 95 % > Atmospheric pressure: 795 hPa - 1060 h
